falsification_contract.TREATMENT: Add an LADRC-FOPIDN dual-loop controller to the vehicle power management unit (alternator field current regulation plus battery/load bus switching) so intermittent faults and load dumps are actively rejected in real time instead of collapsing the electrical bus.

falsification_contract.MEASUREMENT: Bench-test the vehicle electrical system with induced intermittent battery/alternator faults at highway load profiles; compare bus voltage retention and engine-shutdown events with vs. without the LADRC-FOPIDN controller — if complete power loss persists, the mechanism is falsified.
